name: Misaki Fuuka
source:
Fuuka is the protagonist’s cousin, and shares many of his interests and hobbies: especially doujinshi making. She idolizes him to no end, equating their relationship as brother and sister, rather than distant relatives. While the protagonist supports and finances her ventures, he mostly does so to keep a close eye on her and ensure she stays out of trouble.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
